million</font></td></tr></table></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">NORWALK, CONNECTICUT, October 29, 2026 - EMCOR Group, Inc. (NYSE&#58; EME) today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Third Quarter 2026 Results of Operations</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For the third quarter of 2026, </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">revenues</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> totaled a quarterly record of $5.54 billion, an increase of 28.8%, compared to revenues of $4.30 billion for the third quarter of 2025. On an organic basis, when adjusting for incremental acquisition contribution and the impact of the sale of the Company's United Kingdom operations in 2025, third quarter revenues increased by 25.5%.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Net income</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the third quarter of 2026 was $399.9 million, or $9.04 per diluted share, compared to net income of $295.4 million, or $6.57 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the third quarter of 2026 included a non-cash impairment loss on identifiable intangible assets of $34.0 million, or $24.7 million after taxes. Excluding such impairment, non-GAAP net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $424.7 million, or $9.60 per diluted share.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Operating income</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the third quarter of 2026 was $545.8 million, or 9.8% of revenues, compared to operating income of $405.7 million, or 9.4% of revenues, for the third quarter of 2025. Excluding the previously referenced impairment loss, non-GAAP operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $579.8 million, or 10.5% of revenues. Operating income included depreciation and amortization expense (inclusive of amortization of identifiable intangible assets) of $57.3 million and $47.8 million for the third quarter of 2026 and 2025, respectively.</font></div><div style="height:54pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;&#8211; MORE &#8211;</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:13.00pt">Refer to the attached tables for a reconciliation of organic revenue growth, non-GAAP operating income, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP net income, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share to the comparable GAAP measures.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Selling, general and administrative expenses</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the third quarter of 2026 totaled $528.4 million, or 9.5% of revenues, compared to $429.6 million, or 10.0% of revenues, for the third quarter of 2025.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company's </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">income tax rate </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">for the third quarter of 2026 was 27.2%, compared to 27.5% for the third quarter of 2025.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Remaining performance obligations</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%"> (&#8220;RPOs&#8221;) as of September 30, 2026 were a record $18.57 billion, compared to $12.61 billion as of September 30, 2025, an increase of $5.96 billion year-over-year, due to new contract awards across the majority of the sectors in which the Company operates. The most significant RPO growth occurred within the Network and Communications market sector as mission critical facilities continue to require substantial electrical infrastructure and increasingly sophisticated cooling systems. The Company also benefited from a broad range of customer investments across other large end markets, including the Healthcare, Water and Wastewater, Institutional, and Manufacturing and Industrial sectors.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Tony Guzzi, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of EMCOR, commented, &#8220;EMCOR delivered another quarter of exceptional growth, margin performance, operating cash flow, and capital allocation. Our strong revenue growth, coupled with excellent field execution and improved SG&#38;A leverage, resulted in meaningful expansion of our operating margin. We continued to outgrow the broader non-residential construction market, reinforcing the depth of demand for our services.&#34;</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:12.00pt;text-decoration:underline">First Nine Months 2026 Results of Operations </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Revenues</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the first nine months of 2026 totaled $15.32 billion, an increase of 22.9%, compared to revenues of $12.47 billion for the first nine months of 2025. On an organic basis, when adjusting for incremental acquisition contribution and the impact of the sale of the Company's United Kingdom operations in 2025, revenues for the first nine months of 2026 increased by 20.8%.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Net income</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the first nine months of 2026 was $1.11 billion, or $24.93 per diluted share, compared to net income of $838.2 million, or $18.53 per diluted share, for the first nine months of 2025. Net income for the first nine months of 2026 included a non-cash impairment loss on identifiable intangible assets of $34.0 million, or $24.7 million after taxes. Net income for the first nine months of 2025 included $9.4 million, or $6.9 million after taxes, of transaction related costs associated with the acquisition of Miller Electric Company. Excluding these items, non-GAAP net income for the first nine months of 2026 was $1.13 billion, or $25.48 per diluted share, and non-GAAP net income for the first nine months of 2025 was $845.2 million, or $18.68 per diluted share.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Operating income</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the first nine months of 2026 was $1.50 billion, or 9.8% of revenues, compared to operating income of $1.14 billion, or 9.1% of revenues, for the first nine months of 2025. Excluding the previously referenced impairment loss in 2026 and transaction costs in 2025, non-GAAP operating income for the first nine months of 2026 was $1.53 billion, or 10.0% of revenues, and non-GAAP operating income for the first nine months of 2025 was $1.15 billion, or 9.2% of revenues. Operating income included depreciation and amortization expense (inclusive of amortization of identifiable intangible assets) of $164.1 million and $136.4 million for the first nine months of 2026 and 2025, respectively.</font></div><div style="height:54pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font 2025.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">Mr. Guzzi Our field leaders continued to exhibit discipline and precision while executing some of the industry's largest and most technically complex projects. The expertise of our foremen, superintendents, project managers, and operating leaders drives safe, reliable execution and supports repeat business with our customers.
